plan.question: What is the difference in facility delivery coverage between Purnia and Kishanganj in 2023?

view.title: Facility delivery coverage by district, 2022–2023
view.note: Each line shows one district. The vertical axis is the percentage of recorded deliveries that took place in a health facility. The insight below states the 2023 gap between Purnia and Kishanganj in percentage points. Values are illustrative and are not official statistics.

interpretation_guard.caveat: The report supplies percentages only; it does not include counts, denominators, or explanatory variables, so the data cannot explain why coverage differs between districts.
